description:
Automate your patch management

Update third-party software, deploy custom scripts, and make impactful configuration changes to your on-prem Windows devices in minutes with PDQ Deploy.
New Features
- Added an in-app warning when installed PDQ Deploy and PDQ Inventory versions do not match
- Added a Firewall Test (Help > Support > Firewall Test) that checks connectivity to PDQ service endpoints from both the console and the PDQ service and reports any that are blocked
- Added a built-in Performance Analyzer under the Help menu > Support that checks your settings and database health to recommend fixes for common performance issues
- Deploy: Added a Migrate Package(s) to Connect right click option that exports the selected packages and opens them in the PDQ Migrate tool, downloading or updating that tool automatically
- Inventory: Added a Migrate Collection(s) to Connect right click option that exports the selected collections and opens them in the PDQ Migrate tool

Improvements
- Inventory: Added a Help Manual reference documenting where every field in the Computer window comes from

Bug Fixes
- Deploy: Fixed a display error in the Command Line Reference section of the help documentation
